Purpose: Labels-only pass of the production-option build (decision 62(2)): the physical surface groups assigned on the CAD entities, before any mesh generation; the registration probe's census (InterfaceAreas carries the label set, no areas - nothing is meshed)

Guards.Statement: rounded metal top edges (TopRounding > 0): the tube rings surround a sharp edge
rounded trench edges (TrenchRounding > 0): the bottom tube splits its substrate and vacuum sectors at a sharp trench wall
sidewall angle below 90 degrees: the tube sections assume vertical metal faces
thin (non-fabricated) metal: no sidewall and no top / bottom edge pair to tube
Overetch 0: the bottom tube needs an etched trench on its substrate side
trench shallower than the tube radius plus the pyramid height: the pyramids would reach the trench floor
the tube inner size does not fit min(Overetch, MetalThickness / 2, CornerIsotropyRadius): no ring fits
a hole narrower than twice the tube reach (Radius + PyramidHeight + the band's ProtectedDistance): the tubes facing each other across it would overlap
a vacuum gap between the metal faces of an upward and a downward process layer narrower than twice the tube reach: the tubes facing each other across it would overlap
a metal edge end that is neither a semantic corner nor on the outer box
a metal edge shorter than the corner clearances at its ends: no tube interval remains
an explicit etch footprint with no side coincident with a metal edge

a producer-default etch collar whose region is not one simple polygon (Physical sides facing each other across a dielectric gap narrower than twice the collar enclose an un-etched island, or the region touches itself): the collar loft takes one simple polygon

Scope.Rule: the prism-tube recipe builds every input whose classes are all in SupportedClasses; an input exhibiting a class in GuardedClasses fails closed at the guard whose error message carries ScopeGuard[<Id>] (Guards); ExhibitedClasses are the classes of this input among both lists, from the frozen inputs (loops, layers, process); MetalLoops counts per plan-view loop the straight sides not on the outer box, and TubeCount = 2 x their sum (a top and a bottom tube per side of every loop)
